Sri S.K. Mishra, A.C.J.
Sri N.S. Dhanik, J.
Mr. J.S. Virk, learned Deputy Advocate General 
for the State. 
Heard Mr. J.S. Virk, the learned Deputy Advocate 
General appearing for the State. 
Since this appeal is filed under Section 374(2) of 
the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, the appeal is 
admitted. 
Call for the scanned/photocopies of the TCRs 
alongwith soft copy of the same. 
List this case after the receipt of the TCRs. 
In the meantime, the Member Secretary, State 
Legal Services Authority is hereby directed to engage 
an Amicus Curiae to argue the case on behalf of the 
appellant, in light of the observations made by the 
Hon’ble Supreme Court in the case ofAnokhiLal v.

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
IA No.1/2024 (Short Term Bail Application)
IN
CRJA No.76 of 2021
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Ms. Medha Pande, learned counsel holding 
brief of Mr. Lalit Sharma, learned counsel for the 
appellant.
2. Mr. J.S. Virk, learned Deputy Advocate 
General along with Mr. Rakesh Joshi, learned 
Brief Holder for the State.
3. This is an jail appeal under Section 374 (2) 
of Cr.P.C. against the judgment and order dated 
25/27.10.2021 passed by Additional Sessions 
Judge, Khatima, District Udham Singh Nagar in 
Sessions Trial No.40 of 2019, whereby appellant 
has been convicted and sentenced as under:-
S.No. Conviction Sentence Fine Sentence in￾lieu of fine
1. 304-B IPC Life 
Imprisonment
Rs.20,000/- Six months’ 
additional 
imprisonment
2. 498-A IPC 02 years’ R.I. Rs.3,000/- Two months’ 
additional 
imprisonment
3. Section 4 
of Dowry 
Prohibition 
Act, 1961
01 year R.I. Rs.2,000/- One month 
additional 
imprisonment
All the sentences were directed to run 
concurrently.
4. Today, the matter is listed on a short term 
bail application.
5. Learned counsel for the appellant submits 
that mother of the appellant has died on  2
05.05.2024, therefore, his presence is necessary 
to perform the last rites and rituals which is 
scheduled for 16.05.2024. 
6. Learned State Counsel was asked to get 
instructions in the matter. 
7. Today, on instructions, learned State 
Counsel endorses the statement made by the 
appellant in short term bail application.
8. For the reasons indicated above, short term 
bail application is allowed. Let the appellant￾Neeraj Parki be enlarged on short term bail only 
for a period of two weeks from the date of his 
release, on his executing personal bond with two 
reliable sureties each of the like amount to the 
satisfaction of the CJM concerned.
9. Upon expiry of two weeks, appellant shall 
surrender before the CJM concerned.
10. Let a certified copy of this order be issued to 
the parties today itself. 
(Pankaj Purohit, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
 14.05.2024
AK
